items.title: Widerspruch against contribution assessment
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse, Gesundheitsplatz 5, 30159 Musterstadt, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 21.05.2026 (posting day). Sender is a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), a social-law body, so § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: delivery = 4th day after posting, and this delivery day is NOT moved even if it falls on a weekend. 21.05 + 4 days = 25.05.2026 (Monday) = deemed delivery date. One-month Widerspruch period per § 84 SGG: the delivery day itself is excluded (§ 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so the period runs from 26.05.2026 and ends one month later on the day numerically corresponding to the delivery day, i.e. 25.06.2026. 25.06.2026 is a Thursday, not a public holiday in NW, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X.

items.title: Monthly contribution collected by direct debit (recurring)
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: Voluntary membership and thus contribution liability starts 01.06.2026. The letter states contributions are collected on the 15th of the month following the contribution month. The first contribution period is June 2026, so the first direct debit occurs on 15.07.2026 (a Wednesday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed). This is a recurring obligation continuing monthly thereafter (15th of each following month) as long as the membership lasts; only the first due date is given here.
